reader.requirement: IN and OF are interchangeable in every qualification format (data and condition-names, paragraph IN section, LINAGE-COUNTER, PAGE-/LINE-COUNTER, report items) with identical meaning.
reader.edition-search: grep for DialectLevel, Edition.Year, EditionContext, CobolVersion, Permissive and ConstructRegistry in NameResolution.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.Procedures.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, QualifiedNameClasses.cs, OccursKeyResolvePass.cs, OdoResolvePass.cs, StatementValidation.cs, DataBinder.cs#UniqueOrReportAmbiguous; the grammar rules qualification, dataReference, procedureName and reportGroupReference carry no version predicate; each grammar alternative is (OF | IN) with no predicate
reader.witnesses-cover: part: data and condition-name qualification; procedure-name, LINAGE-COUNTER, report counters and cd-name qualifiers are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: AAAA BBBB / CCCC DDDD / OK-R1-A OK-R1-B OK-R2-C OK-R2-D / 78 / 123 / CCCC / UNIQ / ZZZZZ / FFF12GGG34
probes.expected: every reference made unique by its qualifiers resolves to its own item: full and gapped chains, IN and OF mixed, record-name as data-name-1 and as qualifier, file-name qualifier, condition-names qualified by their conditional variable and its groups, subscripted qualified items, an unqualified unique name

probes.printed: exit 0: S1-P1 / S2-P1 x3 / S1-P2 / S1-P1 / S1-P2 / LC 03 02 / END
probes.expected: P1 OF S1, P1 IN S2, unqualified P1 from within S2, PERFORM P1 OF S1 THRU P2 IN S1, GO TO FIN OF S9, LINAGE-COUNTER OF/IN file all resolve
PAGE-COUNTER/LINE-COUNTER OF/IN report-name resolve (format 5, IN and OF equivalent)
DEST-COUNT OF CDA and DEST-COUNT IN OREC2 IN CDB resolve through format 1's cd-name qualifier
qualified RECORD KEY, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, RELATIVE KEY, FILE STATUS and READ KEY IS resolve; indexed dynamic and relative random; a failed READ gives 23

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.3  the text is in SRL2.3 (quoted: IN and OF are logically equivalent)

reader.notes: Every grammar rule that takes a qualifier spells it (OF | IN) and the binder reads only the qualifier word, so the two cannot differ; probes mix IN and OF in one chain in each format and get the same item.

refuter.evidence: Format 3: CopyProcessor.cs (the COPY statement parse) takes w.IsWord("OF") || w.IsWord("IN") alike; cpy1.cob COPY NOSUCH IN NOLIB and COPY NOSUCH OF NOLIB give the identical CBL3620. Format 6: rw6.cob GENERATE D IN RA / D OF RB and USE BEFORE REPORTING D OF RB -> BEFORE DB twice, LINE-COUNTER IN RA / OF RB. dbq.cob: USE FOR DEBUGGING ON P1 IN S1 V IN R2 fires for PERFORM P1 OF S1 and MOVE TO V OF R2. cite: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SRL2.3  the text is in SRL2.3.
